lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of vertical columns containing 4 to 6 high-luminance circular clusters, posterior to the gill slits, forming a regular 2D grid along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Elevated pixel intensity in vertical bands serves as a backdrop for the circular blobs, creating distinct intersection nodes throughout the visible flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to a shadow gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct symbiotic organism (likely a remora) attached to the ventral region posterior to the left pectoral fin.
